author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Cybercrime group ShinyHunters leaked data allegedly stolen from Charter Communications, exposing millions of customer records after a failed extortion attempt. The ShinyHunters extortion group has published data allegedly stolen from Charter Communications after the company apparently refused to pay a ransom. title: ShinyHunters Leaks Charter Communications Data, Potentially Impacting 5 Million Customers

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Attackers are texting Signal users posing as Support, asking for backup recovery keys. Once obtained, they can decrypt the entire message history, not just future chats. A phishing campaign is currently targeting Signal users with text messages that impersonate Signal Support and ask them to hand over their backup recovery key. The message looks urgent, […]
title: Signal Phishing Campaign Targets Journalists and Activists to Steal Backup Recovery Keys

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Dutch authorities seized 200 servers running a 17-million-device botnet linked to proxy service Asocks. Dutch authorities have taken offline a massive botnet of at least 17 million devices and seized more than 200 servers at a local provider that supported the operation.
